thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: High tail latency detected on serving-cluster-7 (p95=420ms, p99=2.3s), streaming stalls observed. Auto-detect: KV cache eviction surge / slab fragmentation.

David-oncall: seeing large number of streaming stalls spikes on prod-us-east-1 since ~8532109600. p95/p99 trending up. Customers calling into CS. I’m on it.

Anne-sre: thanks. quick summary pls — are we seeing prefill vs decode imbalance or pure eviction pressure?

David-oncall: initial look: prefill workers spiking CPU, some shards reporting high prefill enqueue + decode latency. eviction_count has jumped ~12x. suspect small hot keys + slab fragmentation -> lots of prefill retries + decode backlog.

Raj-reliability: adding metrics snippet:
```
metric: serving.cluster.7.kv.evictions: 1280/min
metric: serving.cluster.7.kv.prefill.queue_depth: 340
metric: serving.cluster.7.kv.decode.latency.p95: 1.1s
metric: serving.cluster.7.streaming.stalls.count: 274
```

Infra-bot: Detected increased GC and OOMs on cache-worker-3. Auto-restart attempted 1x. No pod crashloop yet.

Liz-support: escalating: two customers reported truncated streams and timeouts. CS requested ETA and mitigation.

Anne-sre: ok. immediate plan: 1) reduce prefill aggressiveness for flushy models 2) raise eviction threshold on shard group to stop oscillation 3) route heavy streaming traffic to fallback pool while we stabilize. Any objections?

David-oncall: thumbs up. Preparing commands.

David-oncall: running:
```bash
# reduce prefill workers for model-family-x
redwoodctl cluster set-config serving-cluster-7 --model-family x --prefill-workers 2
# bump eviction threshold 10%
redwoodctl cluster set-config serving-cluster-7 --kv-eviction-threshold 0.85
```

Anne-sre: also run quick slab compaction on the most-fragmented shards (shard ids: 7-9). Use safe mode (no full evict).

Raj-reliability: launching compaction job now, will stream logs.

Infra-bot: compaction job queued: job-id=comp-8532109901 targeting shards=[7,8,9]. ETA 45s.

David-oncall: routing change queued: shift 20% streaming traffic to fallback-pool-us-east-2 to reduce load.

Anne-sre: keep prefill disabled for model-family-y (experimental large context models) until we confirm decode latency drops. That model's prefill has a bad allocation pattern.

David-oncall: done: set prefill-workers=0 for model-family-y. routing applied. compaction started.

Raj-reliability: compaction logs: chunked free-list coalesced, freeing ~1.1GB fragmented space across shards 7-9. No eviction storms triggered.

David-oncall: immediate metrics post-actions: p95 -> 180ms (was 420ms), p99 -> 980ms (was 2.3s), streaming stalls down from 274 -> 48 in last 5m.

Liz-support: relaying to CS: "We've applied targeted mitigations; impact reduced. Keeping monitoring, will update in 15m."

Anne-sre: good. next: followup actions to avoid recurrence: - analyze key hotness distribution and add hotspot routing - enable slab defrag schedule during low-traffic windows - add prefill backoff when decode latency > 500ms - add circuit-breaker to avoid prefill spikes per-shard.

David-oncall: filing followup ticket, linking observed events and commands used. ticket: INF-8241.

Raj-reliability: quick note: we saw an oscillation pattern where prefill would re-enqueue keys after failed decode -> immediate re-prefill -> eviction pressure -> more fragmentation. The compact + temporary prefill disable broke that loop.

Anne-sre: good callout. We should instrument retry path to add exponential backoff on failed decode.

David-oncall: one more metric dump for SLO reporting:
```
before: p95=420ms p99=2300ms errors=0.8% streaming_stalls=274
after:  p95=165ms p99=720ms errors=0.12% streaming_stalls=38
```

Liz-support: customers A and B confirmed improved behavior. A was seeing >10% stream truncation, now back to normal.

Anne-sre: rolling out a conservative config change cluster-wide: increase kv-eviction-threshold from 0.8 -> 0.83 for all clusters in region-us-east to reduce thrash. We'll monitor for memory pressure.

David-oncall: change applied. Watching memory usage; currently +3% used, acceptable.

Infra-bot: note: compaction job completed successfully. job-id=comp-8532109901. freed_total=1.1GB.

Raj-reliability: creating longer-term action items in INF-8241: hotspot routing, exponential backoff for prefill retries, telemetry for prefill/decode imbalance, scheduled slab defrag.

Anne-sre: ok. next oncall handoff at 8532113200 (in ~7m). I'll leave this in monitoring state. if p99 creeps above 1.5s reboot escalate.

David-oncall: leaving a short runbook in the ticket with exec steps we took and the two rollbacks (prefill workers -> 0 for y, eviction threshold bump).

Liz-support: notified CS and downstream account managers.

Ops-rotation: taking handoff. thanks team. I'll watch the dashboards and be ready to revert the eviction-threshold bump if mem pressure >85%.

Anne-sre: thanks. tagging INF-8241 and assigning to raj for followups. Closing live mitigation thread, keeping channel for any followups. :thumbsup:"
